tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are planning a trip with your classmates to a popular tourist destination during your semester break. You need to book accommodations and ensure the hotel can meet your group's needs. You want to contact the hotel to confirm these details.
Write an email to Mr. Carter. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Explain the purpose of your trip and the number of people in your group.
Request the hotel send any additional information needed.
tasks.to: Mr. Carter Subject: Trip Accommodation Inquiry
tasks.subject: Trip Accommodation Inquiry
tasks.title: Write an Email
